verdict.rationale: Access to engine source is a fair question for any game engine, but the evidence never says Summer Engine's source is available to read or modify. The only nearby claim is that developers can 'use native C++ and C#' for full control. That describes writing game code in native languages, which is an adjacent feature, not access to the engine's own source.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can read and modify the full engine source when I hit a wall
